title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
authors: A. Radford, K. Narasimhan, T. Salimans, I. Sutskever
before: Pretraining was done with recurrent models and mostly produced features, not generators.
problem: Could a single generative pretrained model be adapted to many understanding tasks?
breakthrough: Pretrain a Transformer decoder on plain text with next-token prediction, then fine-tune with a task head.
why: The decoder-only bet. Unfashionable next to BERT at the time, and the line that led to everything from GPT-3 onward.
next: GPT-2 scaled it and dropped the fine-tuning step for many tasks.
inherits: The architecture and objective of every modern LLM.
